headline: ILLIT earn 'SHOW K-POP' triple crown
sub: 4th music show win for 'You're Under Arrest', with 8,064 points
caption:
ILLIT have taken a triple crown on Arirang TV's 'SHOW K-POP' with 'You're Under Arrest'!

The group topped the Nov 23 episode with 8,064 points, beating A2O LITE's 'NEON'. It's the song's third win on the show and its fourth music show trophy overall. 'You're Under Arrest' is the title track of ILLIT's 5th mini album 'BREAK EVEN', released Oct 26.

📌 Source: Arirang TV 'SHOW K-POP', Soompi
